Subfigures

Top left

temp1a_state = state_wis |>
    group_by(model_id, target) |>
    summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis), count = n(), .groups = "drop")
temp1a_state$type = "state-scoring"

temp1a_standard = standard_wis |>
    group_by(model_id, target) |>
    summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis), count = n(), .groups = "drop")
temp1a_standard$type = "standard-scoring"

temp1a = rbind(temp1a_standard, temp1a_state)
temp1a = temp1a |>
    filter(target == "Flu ED visits pct")
figure1a = ggplot(temp1a, aes(x = fct_reorder(model_id, mean_wis,
    .fun = max), y = mean_wis, fill = type)) + geom_col(position = "dodge",
    color = "black") + scale_fill_manual(values = c(`standard-scoring` = "firebrick",
    `state-scoring` = "royalblue")) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,
    2.5), breaks = c(0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3), expand = expansion(mult = 0,
    add = 0.03)) + labs(x = "Model", y = "Mean WIS", fill = "Scoring Method") +
    theme_bw() + theme_bw() + theme(text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16), axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16), legend.title = element_text(size = 17),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 17)) + theme(legend.position = "top") +
    coord_flip()

figure1a

Bottom left

state_wis <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/state-scoring/state_wis.csv")
state_wis = state_wis |>
    rename(state_wis = wis)

complete_wis <- state_wis %>%
    left_join(standard_wis, by = intersect(colnames(state_wis),
        colnames(standard_wis)))

complete_wis$relative_wis <- complete_wis$state_wis/complete_wis$wis
complete_wis = complete_wis |>
    select("location", "target_end_date", "horizon", "reference_date",
        "model_id", "target", "wis", "state_wis", "relative_wis")
sum(is.na(complete_wis))
## [1] 101365
complete_wis = na.omit(complete_wis)
complete_wis_summary <- complete_wis %>%
    group_by(model_id) %>%
    summarise(mean_relative_wis = mean(relative_wis[!is.infinite(relative_wis)]),
        count = n(), .groups = "drop")
temp1c = complete_wis_summary |>
    filter(model_id != "epiENGAGE-GBQR")
figure1c = ggplot(temp1c, aes(x = fct_reorder(model_id, mean_relative_wis,
    .fun = sum), y = mean_relative_wis)) + geom_col(fill = "firebrick",
    color = "black") + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0,
    add = 0.03)) + labs(x = "Model", y = "Mean Relative WIS (values exceeding 1 are infinite)") +
    theme_bw() + theme(text = element_text(size = 18), axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18), legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 17), strip.text = element_text(size = 17)) +
    theme(legend.position = "top") + coord_flip()

figure1c
